name: keep-mac-awake
description: Lets your agent keep a MacBook with Apple silicon awake with the lid closed while long tasks run, through the keepmacawake command of the Keep Mac Awake app: it starts a timed session before long work, stops it after, and tells you when the app needs your attention. Requires the Keep Mac Awake app, a paid app with a free trial.

interface.shortDescription: Keep a MacBook awake with the lid closed while long tasks run
interface.longDescription: Before long work, the agent starts a timed Keep Mac Awake session, so the MacBook keeps running with the lid closed while you check in from your phone; it stops the session when the work is done. It always asks before a session without a time limit, battery use, installing the app and buying. Requires the Keep Mac Awake app on a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later.
defaultPrompt: Run the full test suite and fix what fails. I'm closing the lid and will check back from my phone.
Keep the Mac awake for the next 2 hours while this migration runs.
